business_summary: Vishnu Prakash R Punglia Limited engages in engineering, procurement, and construction of infrastructure projects in India. The company undertakes various projects, including water supply and sewerage networks; railways, highways, and bridges; roads; irrigation network projects; multistorey buildings and warehouses; and tunnels in hydropower, railways, metro rail, roads, and highways, as well as operation and maintenance works. The company is also involved in development of multi-dimensional smart city projects; and automation work involving PLC and SCADA. It serves central and state government, local bodies, public sector companies, world bank projects, and private bodies. Vishnu Prakash R Punglia Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in Jodhpur, India.
